title: MPRIS Integration
line: Music playing on a phone connected over Bluetooth now shows in the Media Player widget and responds to the media keys.
explanation: BlueZ exposes a connected phone's media player (AVRCP) only as org.bluez.MediaPlayer1, and nothing in Plasma turned that into MPRIS, so the player could only be controlled from the device's expanded entry in the Bluetooth applet. The Media Player widget, its tray tooltip, the media keys and the lock screen controls, which all read MPRIS, never saw it. Bluedevil's kded module now exports every device's media player as an MPRIS player (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.bluedevil.dev_<address>, identity = device name) with status, track metadata, position, play/pause/stop/next/previous, and removes it when the player or device goes away.

commits.message:
kded: export Bluetooth media players as MPRIS players

A phone's media player (AVRCP) could only be controlled from its entry
in the Bluetooth applet, so the Media Player widget and the media keys
ignored it. The daemon now exports each one as an MPRIS player as well.

BUG: 377641
